sources.label: Zhou et al. — selective blood-to-brain protein transport, Cell (2026)

research.summary: In falling snow, a travelling seller offers a mandarin to a woman above the stair. Inspired by Zhou and colleagues’ Cell study, published online on 11 November 2026: in mice, diverse plasma proteins cross the blood-brain barrier and reach distinct brain cell types. Early-stage 5xFAD mice show selective changes, including reduced APOA1 and increased SERPINA1 uptake, rather than a uniform change in transport.

title: A Handful of Summer · 一捧夏天
